response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.pair_avg - o.overall_mean) AS avg_above_overall FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.overall_mean GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_above_overall, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_type_mean FROM type_averages;
